item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in Iran in Its Third Week
item.summary: The Persian new year and the end of the holy month of Ramadan were marked by continuing strikes in the region as the war reached the end of its third week.

item.title: U.S. Attacks Iranian Targets to Try to Open Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The Israeli military said it had killed the spokesman for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, and Iran warned that it could target American and Israeli military personnel.

item.title: Switzerland Blocks Arms Sales to U.S. Over Iran War
item.summary: Swiss law prohibits selling war materiel to countries involved in armed conflict, a policy the country has already cited to block sales to Israel and Iran.

item.title: U.K. Allows U.S. to Use Bases to Hit Iranian Forces Menacing Strait Traffic
item.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has vowed not to be dragged into the war with Iran, but his government described its new position as essentially defensive.

item.title: Iran’s New Supreme Leader Issues a Statement but Remains Unseen
item.summary: Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has remained out of the public’s sight since assuming the post, amid reports that he was badly wounded.

item.title: Hamas Considering Disarmament Plan From Trump’s Board of Peace, Officials Say
item.summary: The proposal envisions a phased process, in which the militant group would hand over its weapons and Israeli troops would withdraw. Hamas is expected to respond in the coming days.

item.title: U.S. Dispatches Marines and Warships to Middle East
item.summary: Officials said 2,500 Marines from 11th Marine Expeditionary Unit in California and the U.S.S. Boxer amphibious ready group will go in April to relieve Marines already deployed in the Persian Gulf.

item.title: NATO Pulls Last Military Trainers From Iraq Amid Strikes From Iran
item.summary: The NATO mission, created in 2018, trained and advised Iraqi forces. Iraq is among the countries facing retaliatory attacks from the U.S.-Israeli war.

item.title: War-Weary Lebanon Marks Eid With Muted Celebration
item.summary: For families displaced by Israeli airstrikes, the joy that usually marks the end of Ramadan has been replaced by uncertainty and hardship.

item.title: A Diary of War From an Unlikely Author: the Son of Iran’s President
item.summary: In an online journal, Yousef Pezeshkian offers readers a mix of personal anecdotes and glimpses behind the scenes as Iranian leaders are picked off one after another.
